from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    background = Counter(row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color != background]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color != background]
    rail_color = Counter([row_modes[r] for r in rows] + [col_modes[c] for c in cols]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            color = corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] != rail_color else background
            line.append(color)
        out.append(line)
    while out and out[0] and all(v == background for v in (row[0] for row in out)):
        for row in out:
            row.pop(0)
    while out and out[0] and all(row[-1] == background for row in out):
        for row in out:
            row.pop()
    return out
'''
file_path=programs/'task-53014a4c.py'
file_path.write_text(program_text)
exec(compile(program_text, str(file_path), 'exec'), globals())
print(file_path)
